input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: polish: sweep all venture pages for hero button rows and sideways scroll; fix 320 px reflow (auto-fit grid minimums) with a static check

errors.what: first platform/pages test run: 170 failures, all one cause: the new post's description was 170 chars (writing.mjs throws on load); shortened to 160 and re-ran

doc_friction.issue: says to screenshot the hub etc. and pick the weakest; after ~30 polish runs today those surfaces show nothing, so the real pick comes from platform/ci/polish_queue.py, which the prompt does not mention
a post's description over 160 chars fails every build test (170 of 1,878) with the same message; check_posts.py catches it in 1 s, so running that before the suite saves a 5-minute run

deviations.why: the picked item was hero button rows; the sweep showed ~180 are form action rows (Check / Load example / Clear) where stretching to full width would make Clear the biggest button, and that it found a WCAG 1.4.10 failure (21 pages sideways at 320 px)
deviations.did: fixed the reflow failure and left the button rows, with the reason and a gentler option in the report
deviations.result: 21 -> 0 sideways pages among the 44 rebuilt; desktop tracks identical on 44 of 44

notes: Sweep: Playwright over 1,414 built venture pages at 390/360/320 (4 min, 8 tabs). Before: 21 sideways at 320, 0 at 360/390. After (--only preview of the 44 touched pages): 0 at every width; computed grid-template-columns identical before/after at 768 and 1280 on 44 of 44 pages. pairwise-ranking stays 1 px over at 320 (not touched). Codemod: 62 grids in 56 files. New check platform/pages/grid-min-reflow.test.mjs 0.5 s. Changed ventures' own tests and platform/pages suite run locally (results in PR).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: front-end dev: sweep script over 1,414 pages, codemod across 56 files, verification at 5 widths, a static check, post and report

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
